# artifactapi_remote_cargo (Resource)

Manages an ArtifactAPI cargo remote, a caching proxy for an upstream repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cargo remote proxies a crates.io sparse registry.
# The provider knows index files are mutable; .crate downloads are immutable.
resource "artifactapi_remote_cargo" "crates_io" {
  name        = "crates-io"
  base_url    = "https://index.crates.io"
  description = "crates.io sparse registry"

  immutable_ttl = 0
  mutable_ttl   = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Upstream repository base URL.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the remote.

### Optional

- `ban_tags` (List of String) Tags to ban (docker only).
- `ban_tags_enabled` (Boolean) Enable tag banning (docker only).
- `blocklist` (List of String) Paths to always deny (checked before patterns).
- `cache_repodata` (Boolean) Cache generated repodata (github_rpm only).
- `check_mutable` (Boolean) Enable conditional revalidation for mutable artifacts.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `immutable_patterns` (List of String) Override: paths that should be immutable even if the provider would classify as mutable.
- `immutable_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds for immutable artifacts (0 = forever).
- `mirror_strategy` (String) Mirror load-balancing strategy across base_url + mirrorlist; only valid on remote rpm/deb/apk (alpine) repos. One of "round_robin" (default) or "least_conn".
- `mirrorlist` (List of String) Extra upstream mirror base URLs; only valid on remote rpm/deb/apk (alpine) repos. Requests are load-balanced with failover across base_url + mirrorlist.
- `mutable_patterns` (List of String) Override: paths that should be mutable even if the provider would classify as immutable.
- `mutable_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds for mutable artifacts.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password or token for upstream authentication.
- `patterns` (List of String) Paths to proxy (empty = all). This is the allowlist.
- `quarantine_days` (Number) Days to quarantine new artifacts when `quarantine_enabled` is set.
- `quarantine_enabled` (Boolean) Hold newly published upstream artifacts back until they are `quarantine_days` old.
- `releases_remote` (String) Name of a backend remote that serves the actual download bytes. Used by the terraform remote (download URL rewriting) and the github_rpm/github_deb/github_alpine remotes (302 redirect of .rpm/.deb/.apk downloads to a generic github.com remote).
- `serve_stale` (Boolean) Let rpm/deb/alpine virtuals serve this member's last good index while it refreshes.
- `stale_on_error` (Boolean) Serve stale cached content when upstream is unreachable.
- `sync_interval` (Number) Release re-scan interval in seconds, 0..2592000 (0 = mutable_ttl); github_rpm/github_deb/github_alpine only.
- `upstream_dial_timeout` (Number) Upstream TCP connect timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
- `upstream_response_header_timeout` (Number) Upstream response-header timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
- `upstream_tls_timeout` (Number) Upstream TLS handshake timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Username for upstream authentication.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import artifactapi_remote_cargo.crates_io crates-io
```
